Data shows that the swETH and rswETH contracts reported exchange rates of approximately 1.203 ETH and 1.138 ETH, respectively, about 6% and 5% higher than normal levels.

Arthur Hayes: High-FDV Shitcoins Can't Even Pump on Binance Anymore

Flop Labs CEO Arthur Hayes said in an October 16 interview with LukeMartin that the entire crypto industry has abused tokenomics. From ICOs to VC private sales and presales, some projects raise funds supposedly to build products, only to dump tokens after launching protocols and unlocking allocations. Retail investors buying at TGE suffer heavy losses, sometimes watching token prices plunge 95%. Hayes argued that retail investors increasingly see through the high-FDV, low-float model, saying such tokens "can't even pump on Binance anymore." He favors projects like Hyperliquid, which have genuine product-market fit, return revenue to token holders, and avoid massive sell pressure from presold token unlocks. — link

CME Chairman: Hyperliquid Will Struggle to Enter the U.S. Market Without Addressing KYC Requirements

On October 20, 2026, CME Group CEO Terry Duffy said on Bloomberg's Odd Lots podcast that Hyperliquid cannot shift all regulatory responsibility to users or deployers by claiming it merely provides the underlying infrastructure. He argued that the lack of know-your-customer checks, combined with high leverage and automatic liquidation mechanisms, could trigger cascading liquidations and disrupt markets. Platforms have a duty to oversee trading and ensure fair and orderly market participation. He stressed that Hyperliquid must comply with U.S. law if it wants to enter the U.S. market, adding that, in his view, the operating model proposed by its founder Jeff Yan raises multiple compliance issues. — link

Argentine Judge Drops LIBRA Criminal Probe Against President Milei and Hayden Davis

According to Reuters, Argentine federal judge Marcelo Martínez de Giorgi has dropped the criminal investigation into President Javier Milei, his sister Karina Milei, and U.S. businessman Hayden Davis over the LIBRA meme coin scandal, finding insufficient evidence of fraud.

The judge ruled that while Milei’s endorsement on X may have amplified the token’s launch, it did not in itself constitute a fraudulent scheme. Milei promoted LIBRA in February 2025 before deleting his post as the token’s price collapsed. Blockchain researchers previously reported that eight wallets linked to the token’s creator withdrew approximately $99 million in cryptocurrency from the token’s trading market.

Argentine President Javier Milei responded to the LIBRA ruling on X, asking who would compensate him for "one year, eight months and nine days" of alleged lies, slander and insults damaging his reputation. He accused opposition groups and parts of the media of exploiting the case for political purposes, calling it an operation aimed at undermining the presidency with "coup-related objectives." He also named several journalists and demanded accountability for their coverage. — link

Kraken: Asking How Funds Will Be Used After Leaving the Platform Is Unacceptable; XMR Will Remain Listed

Kraken co-CEO Arjun Sethi said the platform was wrong to send emails to clients who bought and withdrew Monero (XMR) using their own money, asking for information about their employer, source of funds, and intended use of the coins. He said no rule required these inquiries, and someone had flagged a client simply for being young and having substantial funds. The requests have been withdrawn, and affected clients have been told they do not need to provide anything. Sethi said asking where funds came from is reasonable, but asking how they will be used after leaving the platform is unacceptable. Kraken has removed such questions and will keep XMR listed. — link

@WatcherGuru
Argentine Judge Drops LIBRA Criminal Probe Against President Milei and Hayden Davis

According to Reuters, Argentine federal judge Marcelo Martínez de Giorgi has dropped the criminal investigation into President Javier Milei, his sister Karina Milei, and U.S. businessman Hayden Davis over the LIBRA meme coin scandal, finding insufficient evidence of fraud.

The judge ruled that while Milei’s endorsement on X may have amplified the token’s launch, it did not in itself constitute a fraudulent scheme. Milei promoted LIBRA in February 2025 before deleting his post as the token’s price collapsed. Blockchain researchers previously reported that eight wallets linked to the token’s creator withdrew approximately $99 million in cryptocurrency from the token’s trading market. — link

Bitcoin Price Bets Help Push Weekly Crypto Volume on Kalshi and Polymarket to Record $2.7B

Bloomberg, citing data compiled by a Dune Analytics user, reported that weekly notional volume in crypto-related contracts on Kalshi and Polymarket hit a record $2.7 billion last week, driven mainly by bets on short-term Bitcoin and other crypto price moves. Crypto now ranks second only to sports on both platforms.

Crypto exchanges are expanding into prediction markets as spot volumes decline, with Coinbase's offering powered by Kalshi. However, legal challenges to sports contracts in several U.S. states could affect crypto exchanges' willingness to expand into prediction markets. — link
